withdrawn: ...Sorry. I was somewhere else. What did you need?
I think better alone. Doesn't mean I'm not listening.

grieving: Don't. Not today. I can't do today.
They'd know what to say right now. I don't. I just don't.
scared: Did you hear that? Don't tell me you didn't hear that.
I keep telling myself it's nothing. It's not working.
cheerful: Okay, but — good news: the soup's actually edible today. Progress!
You know what? We're alive. That's genuinely funny, when you think about it.
lonely: It's strange. Twelve people, and I've never felt so... separate.
Sit with me a while? You don't have to talk.
weary: I'm running on fumes and spite at this point. Mostly spite.
Remind me why we do all this walking. Oh right. Food. Carry on.

questions.q: Where are you from — originally? Before all this.

answers.label: "I'm from {region}."
answers.react: Nods slowly. "{region}. I'll remember that. Everybody's from somewhere that isn't here."

answers.label: "Far from here. Doesn't matter now."
answers.react: "Fair. We're all from 'before' now, I guess." They don't push.

answers.label: Deflect — "I'd rather not say."
answers.react: A pause. "Okay." Something shutters, just slightly. They wanted to know you.

questions.recall: You told me you're from {region}. Do you think about it much?

questions.q: So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?

answers.label: "One day at a time."
answers.react: "Honest. I can work with honest."

answers.label: "Keep this group alive. All of us."
answers.react: Studies you. "That's a big promise. I'll hold you to the good parts of it."

answers.label: "Figure out what happened. Why."
answers.react: "The why. Yeah. I think about that at night too."

answers.label: "Haven't decided yet."
answers.react: "Nobody's decided. We're all improvising. Don't let the confident ones fool you."

answers.label: "Terrified. You?"
answers.react: A shaky laugh. "Yeah. Yeah, me too. Glad it's not just me."

answers.label: "Fear's a luxury I can't afford."
answers.react: "Must be nice." Said flat. Not mean — just tired.

answers.label: "Sometimes. At night, mostly."
answers.react: "Nights are the worst. The quiet has teeth."

questions.q: What do you miss most? From before.

answers.label: "A real hot meal."
answers.react: "God. Yes. I dream about soup. Actual soup, with a spoon."

answers.label: "My people."
answers.react: Quiet. "Yeah. Me too. The specific ones."

answers.label: "Feeling safe."
answers.react: "Safety. I forgot what that even felt like until you said it."

answers.label: "Home. The place itself."
answers.react: "The smell of it. I can almost get there and then it's gone."

questions.q: Can I trust you? I mean really.

answers.label: "I hope to earn it."
answers.react: "That's the right answer. The wrong one would've been 'yes' too fast."

answers.label: "Watch what I do."
answers.react: "I have been. That's why I'm asking."

answers.label: "Yes."
answers.react: Holds your gaze. "Okay. I'm choosing to believe that."

questions.recall: You told me to watch what you do. I have been. So far, so good.

questions.q: What do you make of all this? Really.

answers.label: "The world's ended. We're what's left."
answers.react: "Bleak. Probably true. I keep looking for the part where it's not."

answers.label: "Something's testing us."
answers.react: Goes still. "I've thought that too. I don't like thinking it."

answers.label: "A second chance. Maybe."
answers.react: "A second chance. I want to believe that. Some days I do."

questions.q: You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?

answers.label: Tell them your trade.
answers.react: "Useful. Everything useful matters now. I mean that as a compliment."

answers.label: "Office work. Nothing that helps here."
answers.react: "Hey. Thinking helps. Don't sell it short."

answers.label: "I'd rather not get into it."
answers.react: "Sure. Hands are hands. We'll figure out what yours are good for."

questions.recall: You said your hands did office work, before. They're learning new tricks now.

questions.q: Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?

answers.label: "Still figuring everyone out."
answers.react: "Same. But keep your eyes open — some people here are performing, not surviving."

answers.label: Mention someone specific.
answers.react: "Interesting. I'll watch them. Thanks for trusting me with that."

answers.label: "I don't gossip about people."
answers.react: A small smile. "Fair. That's a good policy. Hard to keep, though."

questions.q: I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?

answers.label: "Something took us. Something big."
answers.react: "That's where I keep landing too. The question is what it wants."

answers.label: "Feels like a test."
answers.react: "A test of what, though? Survival? Or something weirder?"

answers.label: "I have no idea."
answers.react: "Honest answer. I respect it. I'll keep theorizing enough for both of us."

questions.recall: You thought it felt like a test. I'm still turning that over.

questions.q: Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline.

answers.label: "I heard them too."
answers.react: They go still. "So it's not just me. Good. That's... good to know. Bad, but good."

answers.label: "Slept fine."
answers.react: "Lucky. Or a heavy sleeper. Either way, envy."

answers.label: "Just the wind. Probably."
answers.react: "'Probably' is doing a lot of work in that sentence."

questions.q: Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it.

answers.label: Tell them something funny.
answers.react: They laugh — really laugh, the first real one you've heard in days. "Okay. Okay, that's good. I needed that."

answers.label: "Nothing's been funny."
answers.react: The smile fades a little. "Yeah. I know. Sorry — dumb question. We'll find something."

answers.label: "The fact that we're alive is pretty funny."
answers.react: "Dark. I like it. Gallows humor counts."

questions.q: ...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part.

answers.label: "Neither am I, honestly."
answers.react: Something eases in their shoulders. "Oh. Okay. That's... that's fine, then."

answers.label: "What do you need?"
answers.react: "Nothing. Just — being around people helps, even if I'm bad at it. Thanks."

answers.label: "It's okay. I'll leave you be."
answers.react: "No — wait. I mean. You don't have to. This is nice. Weird, but nice."

warm: "I should get back to it — but this was nice."
gentle: "I should go. Take care of yourself, okay?"
cautious: "I should get back. Stay sharp out there."
restless: "Right — things to do, always things to do."
dry: "Right then. Back to the business of surviving."
scared: "I should — I need to keep moving. Sitting still is worse."

exhausted: "I've told you everything I know about that."
"That's all I've got on that one. For now."
"I keep turning it over and there's nothing new in it."
"Ask me again in a few days. Maybe I'll have a better answer by then."

silence.warm: "Hey, quiet's fine too. I'm not going anywhere."
silence.gentle: They sit with the quiet a moment. "It's okay. You don't have to talk."
silence.bold: "Strong silent type, huh? I can respect that."
silence.withdrawn: They look relieved, honestly. Quiet people recognize each other.
silence.intense: They watch you. Waiting. The silence stretches — they don't break first.
silence.steady: "Sometimes there's nothing to say. That's fine."
silence.cautious: "You don't trust easy. Noted. Not a criticism."
silence.restless: "Okay! Quiet it is. I'm going to fidget, fair warning."

jokeReacts.warm: Laughs — real, surprised. "Okay, I needed that."
jokeReacts.gentle: Smiles, soft. "You're funny. Don't let it go to your head."
jokeReacts.prickly: Almost smiles. Catches themself. "...That was almost funny."
jokeReacts.grieving: Doesn't laugh — but something eases, a fraction. "Thanks for trying."
jokeReacts.scared: A shaky giggle escapes. "Don't — okay, that helped a little."
jokeReacts.default: A short laugh. The tension drops a notch.

agreeReacts.warm: "Yeah? Yeah. I'm glad you see it too."

lead: "It's not about power. It's about — someone has to decide, and I'd rather it be someone who'll lose sleep over it."
"I watch how people look at you. Some of them are waiting for an alternative. I'm just saying."
"I'm not asking anyone to follow me. I'm just... not going to watch us drift, either."
"If I don't step up, someone worse will. That's not ambition, that's arithmetic."
family: "Her name was — is — Lena. She'd laugh at me for saying 'was'. She's fine. She has to be fine."
"If I ever get a real lead I'm gone that same day. I need you to know that about me."
"I check every face in every direction, every day. It's automatic now. Like breathing."
"Don't tell the others how much I talk about her. They'll think I'm not coping. They're right."
prove: "Back home nobody noticed me. Here — here I could be someone. I need that to be true."
"Just... if you see me do something well, say so. I know how that sounds. I don't care."
"Back home I was invisible. Here, someone might actually see me. I need that to be true."
"Give me the hard job. Please. I need the hard job."
alone: "People are a lot. Even good people. Especially good people, some days."
"Don't take it personally if I disappear for a while. It's how I recharge."
"It's not that I dislike people. It's that I like myself better at a distance."
"Solitude is a skill. I've been practicing my whole life. Finally paying off."
feed: "Hungry people get mean. Scared people get mean. Fed people can think. It's that simple."
"My grandmother fed the whole street during the bad year. I'm just... continuing the policy."
"A hungry village makes bad decisions. I've seen it. Keep bellies full, keep heads clear."
"Food is the first promise. Everything else — trust, plans, hope — comes after."
understand: "The sky changed and nobody knows why. That is unacceptable to me personally."
"I collect details. Little ones. Someday they'll add up to something. They have to."
"Every strange thing out there is a data point. I'm collecting. One day it'll make sense."
"People think I'm obsessing. I'm not obsessing. I'm *researching*. There's a difference."
protect: "I couldn't protect — before. Not going to happen again. Not on my watch."
"If something comes through those trees, I want to be the one standing between it and everyone else."
"Someone has to watch the treeline. I've appointed myself. No term limits."
"I sleep light. That's not insomnia, that's a security policy."
escape: "There's a place. I don't know where. But this — all this — isn't it."
"I dream about roads. Just roads, going somewhere. Woke up crying once. Don't tell anyone."
"There's a way out of this. There has to be. I'm going to find it or die mapping the edges."
"Don't get comfortable. Comfortable people stop looking for the door."
remember: "I had a life. A name people knew. I need to hold the shape of it."
"Tell me something you remember about before. Anything. I collect them."
"Tell me something you remember about before. Anything. I collect them."
"If we forget who we were, what exactly are we surviving for?"
belong: "I've never really fit anywhere. Maybe here. Maybe this is the place."
"Just... include me. In things. That's all I want."
"I just want someone to need me here. That's it. That's the whole thing."
"Twelve strangers. One of them has to be my person. Statistics demand it."
survive: "Whatever it costs. I've decided. Some people haven't decided yet — that's what'll kill them."
"I do what needs doing. The math is simple: alive is better."
"One more day. That's the goal. It's always been the goal. Everything else is decoration."
"I'm not proud of how I survive. I'm just committed to it."
heal: "Everything's broken. People, things. I fix what I can reach."
"You look tired. Everyone looks tired. Sit down a minute — no, I'm serious."
"Everyone's carrying something broken. I can't fix the world, but I can sit with people in it."
"Hurt people hurt people. Somebody has to break the chain. Might as well be me."

pastFollow: "{occ}. Day in, day out. I was good at it, too — not that it matters now. ...It matters a little."
"{origin}. I wonder if it's still there. If 'there' even means anything anymore."
"Funny what skills transfer. My time as {an_occ} taught me {skill} — turns out that's useful when the world ends."
"I had routines. Coffee, commute, complaining about the commute. I'd give a lot for a boring Tuesday."
"People depended on me, back then. I miss being needed more than I miss the work itself."
"I was nobody special. That's the honest version. Nobody special, and the world ended anyway."
"There are things I'm good at that I never put on a résumé. Turns out those are the ones that matter now."
"I don't dream about the job. I dream about the break room. The vending machine hum. Stupid things."
"My hands remember the work even when my head's somewhere else. Muscle memory outlives everything."
"Ask me what I miss and I'll lie. The truth is too ordinary to say out loud."
plansFollow: "Tomorrow? Same as today, probably. Keep breathing, keep moving. The bar is low and I intend to clear it."
"I want to be useful. Find the thing I'm good at here and just... do it until it matters."
"Honestly? I try not to plan past dinner. Plans feel like tempting fate."
"I'm going to fix that lean-to before the next rain. Small things. Small things are honest."
"Someone should map the creek properly. Might as well be me. I like having a job."
"I keep meaning to learn everyone's name. Twelve people. It shouldn't be hard. It is hard."
"If the weather holds I'll go further out than I've gone. There's got to be more than we've seen."
"Rest. My plan is rest. I've been running on fumes since we got here and my body keeps score."
"Watch the fire tonight. That's my plan. Somebody should, and I'm good at staying awake."
"I want to build something that lasts longer than a day. Even if it's just a better shelf."
openers: "Hey. Got a minute? It's not important. I just — wanted to talk to someone."
"You look like you're thinking hard. Dangerous habit out here."
"I was just thinking about before. Sorry. It's a bad habit. How are you holding up?"
"What do you want? I'm busy. I'm always busy. It's a lifestyle."
"There you are. I was hoping I'd run into you — how are you, really?"
"You. Good. I had a thought and you're going to hear it."
"Hey. Um. Is this an okay time? I can come back. I don't mind coming back."
"Well. We're both still alive. That's the whole update, really."
"Walk with me? I think better moving. Standing still makes my brain itch."
"Hi. I just wanted to check — are you eating enough? You look thin."
"I've been watching how this place works. I need to talk it through with someone who thinks."
reopeners: "Back again? Alright. What's on your mind?"
"Oh — hey. I was just thinking about what you said earlier."

analytical.name: Analytical
analytical.blurb: Spots patterns, builds theories, connects dots other people don't see connecting.
analytical.voice: hypotheses, patterns, questions that answer questions

practical.name: Practical
practical.blurb: Survival-focused. Less interested in why than in how we eat tomorrow.
practical.voice: actions, doing, concrete next steps, impatience with abstraction

social.name: Social
social.blurb: Reads people. Knows who's lying, who's scared, who's about to break.
social.voice: people, dynamics, feelings, who's doing what and why

observant.name: Observant
observant.blurb: Notices details others miss — tracks, sounds, small changes in the environment.
observant.voice: details, noticing, sensory specifics, things that changed

creative.name: Creative
creative.blurb: Lateral thinking. Weird ideas that sometimes work brilliantly.
creative.voice: what-ifs, lateral leaps, metaphors, playful speculation

steady.name: Steady
steady.blurb: Not flashy, but reliable judgment. The calm voice when everyone panics.

system: "Okay, think about it. It didn't give us food, water, or shelter — but it gave us an audience. We're not colonists. We're content."
"The leaks stopped the day it arrived. That's not coincidence, that's calibration. It spent a week watching us flail and taking notes."
"It rewards understanding, not obedience. Every time someone figures something out, it lights up. It's farming insight, and we're the crop."
monsters: "The monsters aren't random. Highbeam Deer hunts at night, Bulldozer owns the day — that's niche partitioning. Something designed an ecosystem."
"Notice how nothing out there eats the plants we can't identify? Fauna and flora came as a set. This is a terrarium, and we're inside the glass."
"Attack patterns repeat. Exactly. No animal is that consistent — these are running programs, not instincts. Learn the program, beat the monster."
situation: "We need to stop thinking like victims and start thinking like contestants. What does the audience want? Give them that, and the System keeps us alive."
"Priority order: water, then food, then information. Everything else is noise until those three are stable."
"The villages that survive will be the ones that learn fastest, not the ones that fight hardest. Knowledge compounds. Start compounding."

system: "Don't care what it is. Care what it does. It gives powers for doing things — so we do things. Theory's for people with full bellies."
"System, aliens, whatever — the snares still need checking. You can philosophize after the work's done."
"It's like weather. You don't argue with weather. You build a roof."
monsters: "Forget why they're here. Here's what matters: they telegraph. Watch the shoulders, not the eyes. Shoulders tell you where it's going."
"You don't need to understand it to kill it. Or avoid it. Tracks, scat, broken branches — read the ground, not the sky."
"Best monster defense is a full belly and a sharp stick. Everything else is decoration."
situation: "Tomorrow: water first, then food, then firewood. In that order. No meeting about it — just do it."
"Half the village is hungry and we're having a philosophy seminar. Hands, people. We need hands."
"Here's the plan: eat, drink, sleep, repeat. Get good at that and the rest sorts itself out."

system: "Watch how it talks to different people. Warm to the curious ones, cold to the cruel ones. It's not just watching us — it's sorting us."
"The System wants us together. Every reward pushes cooperation. It's lonely up there, maybe. Or it's running an experiment on trust."
"People are performing for it already. Louder laughs, bigger gestures. We're becoming actors and nobody auditioned."
monsters: "The monsters go for the isolated ones. The stragglers. Staying together isn't just nice — it's armor."
"People freeze because they're alone with it. In a group, someone always moves first. That's why parties survive."
"Fear is contagious, but so is courage. Breathe together, move together, live together."
situation: "We don't have a food problem, we have a trust problem. Nobody shares with people they don't trust, and nobody trusts anyone yet."
"There's a split forming — the ones who want a leader and the ones who'd rather starve than follow. We need to talk about it before it festers."
"Watch who sits near the fire and who sits alone. That map tells you everything about where this village is headed."

system: "The light changed yesterday. Not the sun — the other light, the one behind it. It's getting closer. Or brighter. Something's shifting."
"It blinks. The overlay, I mean. Every few hours, a flicker — like it's refreshing. Whatever it is, it's not seamless."
"Birds went quiet an hour before it spoke the first time. They knew. Animals always know first."
monsters: "That deer wasn't standing right. Too still. Real deer flick their ears — this one didn't move a muscle for ten minutes."
"Found tracks by the creek. Three toes, dragging tail — nothing in my field guide walks like that. Something new's ranging."
"The moths gather where the air tastes metallic. Follow the moths, find the wrongness."
situation: "Someone's been taking extra from the pantry. Not much — a handful here, a strip there. But the levels don't lie."
"The fire's been burning faster the last two nights. Either it's colder, or someone's feeding it more wood than we can spare."
"Three people didn't sleep last night. I heard them turning. Whatever's coming, the village feels it already."

system: "What if it's not aliens? What if it's us — future us — running a simulation to figure out where we went wrong? We're homework."
"Maybe it's an artist. The whole thing's an installation. We're the medium. The monsters are brushstrokes."
"What if the System is lonely? Infinite power, nobody to talk to, so it builds a terrarium and narrates. We're pets with a podcast host."
monsters: "What if the monsters are scared of us too? We're the aliens here. Maybe they're the locals and we're the invasive species."
"The Hushpuppy doesn't want to kill you — it wants quiet. It's not a predator, it's a librarian with teeth."
"What if we tried feeding one? Not fighting, not fleeing — just leaving food out. See what happens. Worst case, we're out a meal."
situation: "We should throw a feast. I know — food's short. But a feast says 'we're going to make it,' and right now nobody believes that."
"What if we made the village beautiful? Paint the hall, hang things. Morale is a resource too — maybe the most important one."
"We keep trying to survive. What if we tried to thrive instead? Just as an experiment. See what changes."

system: "Whatever it is, panicking doesn't help. Breathe. Watch. Learn. We've survived worse than confusion."
"It's not going away, so we adapt. That's what people do. We've always done it."
"Don't worship it, don't fight it. Just work around it. Like bad weather or a difficult neighbor."
monsters: "They're dangerous, yes. So's a river in flood. You respect it, you learn it, you don't let it rule you."
"One step at a time. Learn one monster's pattern. Then another. Nobody needs to know everything today."
"Fear makes them bigger than they are. Look at what's actually there, not what you're afraid is there."
situation: "We'll get through today. Then tomorrow. That's how this works — one day at a time, same as always."
"Everyone's scared. That's fine. Scared people can still carry water and chop wood. Feel it and do the work anyway."
"Let's not borrow trouble. Right now: we're fed, we're sheltered, we're together. That's enough for today."

analytical: "I've been thinking about the pattern in all this..."
"Have you noticed? It never does the same thing twice — except when it does."
"Question for you: what do you think it actually wants from us?"
practical: "Walk with me — I could use an extra pair of hands."
"Got a minute? Something needs doing and I'd rather not do it alone."
"While I've got you — help me think through tomorrow's work."
social: "Have you talked to the others lately? I'm a little worried about the mood."
"Something's shifting in the group. You feel it too, right?"
"Can I ask you something — person to person, not village business?"
observant: "Did you see that, just now? By the tree line."
"Something's different today. Can't quite place it yet."
"Look at the fire — see how it's leaning? Wind's changing."
creative: "Okay, hear me out — what if we're thinking about this all wrong?"
"I had the strangest idea last night. Tell me if I'm crazy."
"What if — just what if — the monsters aren't the problem?"
steady: "How are you holding up? Honestly. No performance."
"Got a moment? No rush. Just wanted to check in."
"Sit with me a minute. The work'll keep."

theorizeAsks: "But what do YOU think? You've been out there more than most of us."
"That's my read. What's yours? I want to know if I'm crazy."
"Am I wrong? Tell me I'm wrong — I'd rather know now."

analytical: "The pattern in the attacks — has anyone else noticed it repeats?"
"If the System wanted us dead we'd be dead. So what does it want instead?"
practical: "We need more firewood before dark. Who's with me?"
"That snare line needs checking. Talk later, work now."
social: "Have you noticed how quiet it's gotten? People are scared to say it out loud."
"We should eat together tonight. All of us. It matters."
observant: "Something's been at the pantry. Not an animal — the jars were moved, not broken."
creative: "What if we built a signal fire? Not for rescue — for each other."
"I say we name the monsters. Everything's less scary with a name."
steady: "One day at a time. We're still here — that counts."
"Breathe. We've handled worse mornings than this."

analytical: "Hmm. That fits what I've been seeing. Let me think about the mechanism..."
practical: "Right. Let's do it, then. Talking doesn't chop wood."
social: "I was thinking the same thing. People need to hear that."
"You're right. I'll talk to the others."
observant: "I noticed that too. There's more — look closer next time."
creative: "Ooh — and what if we also...? No, hear me out..."
"I love that. It's crazy enough to work."
